character.name:
Althea Niel H. Capule (The Supporter)
Physical: A young girl with long, bright pink hair that stands out against the dark city. She has large, expressive eyes and a nervous but hopeful smile.

Cyber-Traditional Style: She wears a stylized Baro’t Saya modified for adventure, featuring neon cyan linings along the embroidery.

Equipment: A tall wooden staff strapped to her back, tipped with a glowing crystal that pulses when she casts [Heal] or [Haste].

Sprite Cues: Eager posture, often clutching her staff with both hands when idle.
